title: Tollgate's rules, on the picture of how it works
desc: The picture of how Tollgate works, with its rules numbered on the parts that keep them. 1, plan first: fresh reviewers check the plan, and each ticket gets a checklist. 2, tests first: one test for each must-have item, locked before any code. 3, build from the best try: below 70%, the AI tries again from its best try. 4, the gate judges: no AI inside, 70% passes, and only the gate says done. 5, stop when stuck: after 3 tries, the advisor decides. 6, risk sets the checks: you merge tiers 3 and 4. 7, mistakes become rules: rules never get looser. 8, always: code enforces every rule, and every word is plain, for people.
